_comment: Dashboard 'Per 10,000 residents' (the Geo data per-capita view, round 13 task 9). Built by dataease/seed-dashboards.mjs (see dataease/README.md). Reads the views dashboards.area_week_per_capita and dashboards.area_geo_data of migration 046: until Geo data is uploaded (DA Management > Data uploads > Geo data) the charts are empty. Counts and organisation names only. pos = [x, y, width, height] on DataEase's 72-column grid; {column} in rich text shows a live value.
